heading: INT. COUNTY PAROLE OFFICE - OPEN-PLAN DESK AREA - DAY

units.text: INT. COUNTY PAROLE OFFICE - OPEN-PLAN DESK AREA - DAY
Cubicles, a dying ficus, a laptop propped on a stack of case files.
Officer DANA REED sits on a Zoom call.
On screen, Dan Reyes, 40s, sits in a kitchen, mug in hand.
ON SCREEN (SLACK): #parole-team - Gus: reminder, Reyes check-in at 2, pls be nice
Dan, thanks for logging in. Three months clean, nice work.
units.name: DANA

units.text: Thanks, Officer Reed. Job's going good. Warehouse hired me full time.
units.name: DAN

units.text: Great. And the ankle monitor is charging overnight?
units.name: DANA

units.text: Every night. Plugged in by the bed.
units.name: DAN

units.text: Good. And you haven't been near Fulton Street?
units.name: DANA

units.text: No, ma'am. Not once.
units.name: DAN

units.text: Across the room Officer GUS PARRA's monitor BUZZES.
He frowns, leans in, and goes pale.
ON SCREEN (SLACK): Gus: Dana.
DANA.
Pull up his GPS.
Now.
Dan, can you hold your mug a little closer to the screen?
units.name: DANA
paren: reading, still smiling at the camera

units.text: Sure.
units.name: DAN

units.text: Behind him, through the window, a street sign.
FULTON ST. A door SLAMS somewhere in the office.
Interesting kitchen.
units.name: DANA

units.text: Officer Reed, I can explain.
units.name: DAN
